_doc: Tutorial steps, main quests and optional challenges. Objective types: talk_mara, move, reach_x, mine_block, collect, use_elevator, smelt, sell, open_panel, skill_rank, own_equipment, ride_to_station, reach_depth, smelt_item, open_geodes, unique_gems, find_cache, sell_value, crush, mine_any, mine_ore, level, cart_ride, event_complete. target can be an item id, block key, panel name, etc.

tutorial.title: Meet Mara
tutorial.text: Walk to Mara and press [E] to talk.
lines: Hey there, rookie! I'm Mara. Welcome to what's left of the old Deepwell camp.
It isn't much yet, but the mountain below us is full of treasure.
Let's get you started. First, stretch those legs!

tutorial.title: Learn to Move
lines: Hold [Shift] to run and press [Space] to jump. Easy, right?

tutorial.title: Enter the Mine
tutorial.text: Walk to the mine entrance and press [E] to go inside.
lines: The mine entrance is just to the east. Walk up to it and press E to head inside!

tutorial.title: Mine Some Stone
tutorial.text: Hold [Left Mouse] on stone next to you. Mine 3 blocks.
lines: This is the Stone Caverns. Aim at a block next to you and hold Left Mouse. Watch it crack!

tutorial.title: Collect Resources
tutorial.text: Collect 10 Stone. Grab the orange Copper Ore too!
lines: Great! You found some ore. Mine it with your pickaxe and collect the resources!

tutorial.title: Ride the Elevator
tutorial.text: Go to the elevator and press [E] to return to camp.
lines: Nice haul! The elevator is just west of this cave. Press E and ride it back to camp.

tutorial.title: Smelt Copper
tutorial.text: Use the Smelter to turn Copper Ore into a Copper Bar.
lines: Raw ore isn't worth much on its own. Load your Copper Ore into the Smelter.

tutorial.title: Sell Your Goods
tutorial.text: Open the Shop and sell something in the Sell tab.
lines: Shiny! The shop pays good coin for bars. Go sell a few.

tutorial.title: The Research Board
tutorial.text: Open the Skill Tree at the Research Board.
lines: Every level you gain earns a Skill Point. The Research Board next to the shop is where you spend them.

tutorial.title: Strong Swing
tutorial.text: Unlock Strong Swing in the Mining Mastery branch.
lines: Everything grows from the Miner's Core. Unlock Strong Swing to hit harder. You can open the tree anytime with [K].

tutorial.title: A Better Tool
tutorial.text: Buy the Copper Pickaxe at the Shop.
lines: Here's $350 from the camp fund. Grab that Copper Pickaxe: it can break the Reinforced Stone guarding the Iron Depths.

tutorial.title: Deeper Down
tutorial.text: Ride the elevator to the Old Workings (150m).
lines: I've repaired the elevator line down to the Old Workings at 150 meters. Ride it down!

tutorial_end: You're getting the hang of it. There's a whole world waiting below us.

main.title: Breakthrough
main.text: Break through the Reinforced Stone and reach the Iron Depths (300m).

main.title: Into the Glow
main.text: Break the Iron-Bound Rock and reach the Crystal Caves (700m).

main.title: Cold Front
main.text: Shatter the Crystal Barrier and reach the Frozen Depths (1200m).

main.title: Fireproof
main.text: Buy Thermal Boots to survive the heat below.

main.title: Trial by Fire
main.text: Cut through the Permafrost Wall and reach the Magma Caverns (1800m).

main.title: The Ancient Core
main.text: Bore through the Magma Shell and reach the Ancient Core (2500m).

main.title: Heart of the Mountain
main.text: Reach the very bottom of the Ancient Core (3150m).
